subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. H is sitting to the immediate right of C. B sitting third to the left of H. P is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate left of C?
solution: **Given:** Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 1) H is sitting to the immediate right of C. 2) B sitting third to the left of H.
